صَلِيقَةٌ Flesh-meat (Jm, O, K) thoroughly cooked, (Jm, TA,) or spread to dry, (مَشْرِىٌّ, O,) or roasted, (مَشْوِىٌّ, K,) and thoroughly cooked: (O, K:) or a piece of roasted flesh-meat: (M:) pl. صَلَائِقُ: (Jm, M, O, K:) accord. to AA, سَلَائِقُ, with س, signifies “ roasted lambs, ” from سَلَقْتُ الشَّاةَ “ I roasted the sheep or goat. ” (TA. See also سَلِيقَةٌ.) ―
-b2- And A thin cake of bread: (M, TA:) accord. to some, (O,) [the pl.] صَلَائِقُ signifies thin bread: (JK, S, O:) but some say that it is صَرَائِقُ, with ر, that has this meaning. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
